body:
GENESIS pass_5 complete: log elegance pass + finished INV-03s real wiring. Build now GEN-0.5.0-dev. 

Part 1 -- log elegance ("study apple and huawei, curate all logs, feel like a product not beta"): redesigned G03_Loggers line format (studied Apples Console.app and Huaweis device-status style) from bracket/pipe debug notation to a calm timestamp-middot-source-middot-message line. Then rewrote every organs own reason/narrative/error string across the whole codebase (G01 ArmController, G02 GateBus, G04 SelfDiagnosis, C01 EdgeAdjudicator, C02 OverfitImmune, C03 EvidenceLedger, C04 ChampionRegister, A02 OrderGate, P03 CostModel) to the same confident sentence-case style -- no more SCREAMING prefixes or raw key=value dumps. Every test-required substring was preserved through the rewrite. The coherence tests own console output was rewritten too, so it now doubles as a live demo of the new feed format. 

Part 2 -- finished INV-03: pass_4 built the GENESIS_Rate type and wired it into G01, but nothing actually produced one from real accumulated counts. Built C03_WinLossTally (record real outcomes, convert to a live rate via the real division, persist across restarts) -- proven end-to-end with a test where 150 real recorded trades at 62% correctly arm. Also upgraded the rates confidence interval from a normal approximation to a real Wilson score interval (better small-sample behavior, matches this projects actual thin ghost-trade samples). While building this, caught and fixed a 3rd instance of the duplicate-constant bug (I07) in the same pass that was auditing for it, before it was ever reported as a gap. 

All 20 test files recompiled 0 errors after every single change, not just at the end. All 20 invariants now have either a constructing organ/type or an explicit documented reason they do not (I16, infra-level). Not yet live-executed in MT4 -- still the ceiling without your explicit consent, same standing rule as always. Attaching: full strategies x source zip, updated GENESIS_LEDGER.json.
